title: Russian Mushroom Dumplings
description: A hearty and comforting Russian-inspired dish featuring sautéed mushrooms in a flaky dumpling crust.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour and warm water. Knead dough for 5 minutes.
Divide dough into 4 equal pieces. Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place 1 tablespoon of filling in the center of each dough circle. Fold dough over filling and press edges together.
In a large skillet, sauté mushrooms, onion, and garlic until softened. Season with parsley, salt, and pepper.
Add cooked dumplings to skillet and simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve hot with your favorite sauce.
